criteria.name: REFINER_FAILURE
criteria.definition: dedicated refiner does not create enough positive action opportunity
criteria.consequence_if_triggered: report as a failure; routing has nothing to route

criteria.name: ROUTER_FAILURE
criteria.definition: learned paired gain fails to outperform simple GT-free routing signals out of sample

criteria.name: PRESERVATION_FAILURE
criteria.definition: routed system materially degrades the global reference

criteria.name: RESOURCE_FAILURE
criteria.definition: router/refiner cost removes the useful compute-performance trade-off

criteria.name: DOMAIN_COLLAPSE
criteria.definition: benefit is concentrated in one domain while another is materially harmed
criteria.consequence_if_triggered: report per-domain harm; macro average may not hide it

criteria.name: H1_SUPPORTED
criteria.definition: learned pre-execution GT-free predictor beats simple proxies at equal budget
criteria.consequence_if_triggered: enables scoped Level-2 wording for the integrated residual

criteria.name: PRESERVATION_SATISFIED
criteria.definition: lower bound of Delta > -0.005 on macro-domain Dice and no domain collapse

criteria.name: FRONTIER_MEASURED
criteria.definition: a measurable accuracy-compute frontier exists across budget points

operationalization.S1: C7 precision_at_budget and/or mean_true_delta_dice_among_routed exceed every simple GT-free proxy (C3/C4/C5/C6) at equal budget; paired bootstrap supports the gap
operationalization.F2: negation of S1: C7 fails to beat simple proxies at equal budget
operationalization.S2: macro_domain_mean_true_delta_dice lower 95% CI bound > -0.005 and no domain collapse
operationalization.F3: macro-domain lower bound <= -0.005 or a routed system materially degrades the reference
operationalization.S3: a monotone-usable accuracy-compute frontier exists across the five budget points
operationalization.F4: router+refiner cost removes the useful compute-performance trade-off
operationalization.F5: benefit concentrated in one domain while another is materially harmed (domain-level routed mean <= -0.01 with a positive domain present)
operationalization.F1: refiner provides insufficient positive action opportunity (Phase25A/25C scope)

adjudication_rule: criteria evaluated on frozen DEV memberships joined to frozen Phase25C outcomes; no criterion may use ROUTER_HOLDOUT/VAL808/TEST
